purpose: An inline <svg> glyph inside a .w-embed wrapper at width=100% height=100%, so the wrapper's CSS sets the rendered size and the viewBox fixes only the aspect ratio.

props.fill: currentColor on every path, so the glyph inherits the themed text colour

notes: Every glyph is inline; the 21 .svg files under public/assets/svg/ are unreferenced duplicates (assets/asset-roles.json publicInventory). A .u-hidden-copy sibling div supplies the text alternative for the logo and sign-in glyphs; the purely decorative glyphs have none.
allowedAssetRolesNote: Machine-checkable list of the assetRole ids this contract may carry, replacing the prose it previously held ('one of brand-wordmark, trusted-partner-logo, ui-icon-glyph'). extraction/verify_all.py check [j] resolves every string under an assetRole key against the closed registry, so a prose sentence there would be - and was - reported as an unlisted role.
